name: Association Landing Page
description: Adds a revisionable landing page entity for associations.
project_description: Submodule of Entity Association. Adds the 'association_page' content entity: a fieldable, revisionable, translatable landing-page entity that shares its ID with the parent association and is bundled by association_type. It is exposed as the 'association_page' landing-page handler plugin, so an association type can use a dedicated managed page as its canonical URL. The page is auto-created with the association and auto-deleted with it (no manual create/delete). View access follows the association's active state; edit and revision curation are gated by per-type page permissions. Provides revision history/view/revert/delete routes and a route enhancer/subscriber that wires the page's field UI and layout-builder tasks onto the association type admin.
